description: This file contains utility functions for theme management in the Notesnook project, including color derivation, CSS generation, and theme variant building.

methods.name: getPreviewColors
methods.description: Generates preview color scheme based on theme definition.

methods.name: themeToCSS
methods.description: Converts theme definition into CSS variables and scope styles.

methods.name: buildVariants
methods.description: Builds theme color variants for a specific scope based on theme and defaults.

methods.name: colorsToCSSVariables
methods.description: Converts color objects into CSS variable declarations.

methods.name: deriveShadeColor
methods.description: Creates a shaded version of a color by changing its alpha transparency.

methods.name: changeColorAlpha
methods.description: Adjusts the alpha transparency of a color hex code.
